text: We need to add a toggle for auto-compile because hot-reloads are making it unusable, hot reload comes -> compile -> locked for 5-6s -> by unlock, the next hot reload hits -> repeat til agent is done
resolution: Added an AUTO-COMPILE toggle to the loader pane (pinned above the LOADER VIEW toggle in the corner). Problem: while an agent edits files, each hot reload re-mounts the cart → re-arms the loader pane's debounced auto-compile → the editor locks 5-6s per bake, back-to-back, unusable. Off → the auto-bake never fires; only the manual Compile button bakes, and the live overlay still shows placements/skins instantly so it costs nothing for most edits. The toggle is PERSISTED in localstore (nsGet/nsSet 'editor.autoCompile', same idiom as the loader-view toggle) — a plain useState would reset to ON on every hot reload and defeat the purpose. The auto-compile effect now gates on loaderView && autoCompile (autoCompile added to deps), so toggling off also clears any pending bake via the effect cleanup. Default stays ON. TSX-only, hot-reloads. Committed 0d736c625.
